text:
ana: Quick thread to lock the customer story flow for BeaconAI. We need: interview done, two approved quotes (hero + expanded), legal clearance on benchmark numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a webinar scheduled for the week after publish. Aim to publish Thursday next week. Can we get everything wrapped by Tue EOD?

tom: I can run the interview next Mon morning. Will focus on deployment pain, infra changes, and the perf wins.

rebecca: I'll coordinate with BeaconAI PR for quote approvals. Also request: don't use raw customer revenue or contract numbers in the blog.

omar: From eng benching: we have the perf snapshot showing median latency down ~65% and p99 down ~3x after moving to Redwood routing and prefix cache. I'll export a redacted CSV for the gated asset.

nina: Great. I'll draft two quote options and tag them hero/long. Hero should be one short sentence, punchy.

ana: (typo) ana: @nina please share early so promo can start building the webinar page.

rebecca: Also ask BeaconAI to confirm public mention of the feature name 5 Signature Stream6. If they don't want the exact name, we'll reword to "real-time signature service".

legal-bot: Please attach the signed NDA and interview consent to this thread. Uploads accepted at https://drive.redwood.work/BeaconAI/ (viewer links preferred).

ops-bot: Publish slot tentative: 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Pending legal sign-off and final copy review.

omar: I'll prepare an appendix with sanitized perf commands. Example skeleton:
```
# benchmark run (sanitized)
./rw_bench --model open-arch-7b --seq 1024 --batch 6 --kv-cache --samples 1500 > bench_out.json
```
Note: will strip internal flags and dataset names per legal guidance.

nina: Draft quotes: 
- hero: "Redwood made our real-time inference reliably fast enough to go live."
- long: "After switching to Redwood's routing and prefix caching we measured a ~65% drop in median latency and a 3x improvement in p99, which let us enable low-latency features for our user base."

rebecca: Those are good. I'll ask BeaconAI to pick one or tweak wording. Remember to change "user base" to "large-scale production users" unless they give explicit permission to use numbers.

ana: ana: Good reminder. Also, marketing ask: please include a short customer blurb for the webinar page (30-40 words) and a two-line speaker bio for the BeaconAI engineer.

tom: Will capture speaker bio during the interview and get approval. For the blog narrative I want the lead to be "operational risk reduced, latency predictable" rather than model accuracy.

omar: Bench artifact path: /mnt/benchmarks/beaconai/redacted-beaconai-2026-04.csv (ops confirms it will be sanitized).

legal-bot: Flag: do not publish specific contract terms or per-user pricing. Also, change any absolute counts (e.g., "millions") to qualitative phrasing unless verified.

nina: I'll post the two quote versions and the short blurb in the shared doc by tomorrow noon.

rebecca: Timeline check: BeaconAI needs 48h to sign off on quotes after the interview. That pushes our deadline; let's confirm interview slot ASAP.

ana: Scheduling: Tom, can you do Mon 9am PT? Rebecca to invite BeaconAI PR and engineer.

tom: Yep, Monday 9 works. I'll send calendar with recording and consent links.

ops-bot: Reminder: add post-publish lead routing rule to send blog MQLs to beacon-ops@ and the Enterprise AE queue. Please confirm routing tag in the publish checklist.

ana: @rebecca @li (cc'ed via DM) make sure inbound routing is tested on the staging page before publish.

rebecca: Will do. Also prepping a small gated PDF with the sanitized CSV + methodology for download behind an email gate. Need legal to review the methodology blurb.

legal-bot: I'll review once draft uploaded. Expect turnaround 48 hours.

nina: Promo plan: announcement post + webinar invite + 2 reminder emails. Need hero quote and speaker name to build the page.

tom: I'll confirm speaker full name during the interview and flag the hero quote for approval.

ana: Summary checklist for clarity:
- Interview: Mon 09:00 PT (Tom)
- Consent + NDA uploaded (BeaconAI)
- Two quote options captured (nina)
- Legal review of numbers + appendix (legal-bot)
- Gated benchmark PDF prepared (rebecca + omar)
- Post-publish lead routing tested (rebecca + ops)
- Webinar page + promo (nina + promo-bot)

promo-bot: Webinar draft page created: /campaigns/beaconai/webinar-draft (staging). Publishable after hero quote added.

ana: Thanks team. Checkpoint Tue EOD to confirm legal clearance and final publish-ready assets.

end of thread.
